rationale: All four acceptance criteria satisfied. DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60 replaces the magic literal. CommandLineInput gains an optional timeout field with a clear schema description. execute() computes effective_timeout via an explicit `is not None` guard (correctly handles timeout=0 if ever needed). subprocess.run receives float(effective_timeout). Backward compatibility: callers that omit timeout see identical behaviour. Five focused tests cover the constant value, schema default/explicit, and both runtime paths (override + fallback). The E501 fix (workflow.py lambda refactor) and S5799 fix (merging split f-strings) are clean hygiene changes. codemie-plugins is untouched per spec. ruff passes; no security regressions.

business_review.criterion: AC1 — timeout aligns with user-configured value
business_review.notes: Per-call timeout parameter overrides the class-level default when provided

business_review.criterion: AC2 — timeout value can be increased and is respected
business_review.notes: timeout field accepted in CommandLineInput schema; value flows to subprocess.run as float(effective_timeout)
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60 constant replaces the magic integer in both the class attribute and the schema description

business_review.criterion: AC4 — clear error messaging when timeout is reached
business_review.notes: Existing subprocess.TimeoutExpired propagation is unchanged; no new suppression introduced

standards_review.notes: Three EPMCDME-10785-prefixed commits with descriptive messages; docs commit included
make ruff passes after S5799 f-string merge fix; E501 fix limited to workflow.py lambda refactor
Five new tests: constant value, schema default/explicit, and both execute() runtime paths via mock subprocess; all pass
No new attack surface; sanitize_command and shell=False unchanged; timeout is an integer field with no injection risk
